_comment: The Dengage web application every demo talks to. Handoff 2.1.
This is the single place these two values are written down. The probe page,
the generator, the smoke test and the CI guardrails all read them from here,
so filling this in is the whole of wiring the repository to the panel.
The application is DND - PreSales eComm [Salil], a new web application inside
account 28. It has its own campaigns and its own push configuration. It does
NOT have its own Data Space: every table and every contact is shared with the
five core demo sites and the two mobile apps. Handoff 14.4.
That sharing is why every page fires pageView before anything else. There is
no column a demo can tag its rows with, so page_url on the page view, and the
session_id join out of it, are the only way back to a demo's own rows.
CLAUDE.md 1b. An earlier revision named a table allowlist here instead; the
allowlist was removed on 4 August 2026 when demos moved to the standard
ecommerce tables, so it no longer describes anything in this repository.
The guardrails treat the app guid as an allowlist of one. Any other
application identifier appearing anywhere in this repository is rejected, so
the identifier the core demos use never has to be written down here in order
to be kept out.
THE SNIPPETS BLOCK IS THE SECOND HALF OF THAT ALLOWLIST, and it is deliberately
a separate field rather than more app guids. Dengage issues a UUID when a
Dynamic Content asset is saved, and the shared email template has to name two of
them or it would import with two empty blocks. They are content ids, not
application ids: nothing sends to a device because of them. Listing them here
rather than in the generator means the guardrails still reject every OTHER
identifier, which is the property worth keeping, and the ids are written down
once. factory/emails/build-beefree.mjs reads them from here.
The SDK loader URL these two compose is
https://pcdn.dengage.com/p/push/28/99d9b8fb-0c62-5a85-3e43-2402554d93a5/dengage_sdk_loader.js
NO CREDENTIALS LIVE IN THIS FILE OR ANYWHERE ELSE IN THIS REPOSITORY.
The Dataspace API is reached with an API user's key and password, exchanged
for a short lived token at login. Both are passed through the environment.
See factory/phase0/create-tables.mjs.
